sources.title: MIVUBI Downed Death Respawn Revive Policy v1

facts.subject: downed state
facts.statement: DOWNED is a project-defined gameplay state layered above engine health/death. It requires explicit authority and must not be inferred solely from low health, crouch input, gamemode, tags, or animation.

facts.subject: player life state
facts.statement: Model arena life state explicitly as ACTIVE, DOWNED, BEING_REVIVED, REVIVED, DEAD_CONFIRMED, RESPAWNING, ELIMINATED, and DISCONNECTED, with generation-scoped transitions.

facts.subject: revive ownership
facts.statement: A downed player must not satisfy their own reviver requirement unless the specific game mode explicitly supports self-revive. Input such as crouch/shift from the downed player is never sufficient evidence of an external reviver.

facts.subject: reviver eligibility
facts.statement: A valid reviver must be a distinct current participant in the same arena generation, connected, eligible, non-downed/non-dead, within the configured interaction condition, and still current when revive completes.

facts.subject: revive transaction
facts.statement: Each downed target generation may have at most one accepted revive transaction owner at a time. Multiple interaction events may request evaluation but cannot create independent completion timers.

facts.subject: revive generation
facts.statement: Revive work must capture target lifeGeneration, target participationGeneration, reviver connectionGeneration, arenaGeneration, and reviveGeneration. Any mismatch invalidates completion.

facts.subject: death transition
facts.statement: DEAD_CONFIRMED immediately invalidates all revive timers, reviver ownership, downed interaction prompts, and low-health recovery callbacks for that life generation.

facts.subject: disconnect during downed/revive
facts.statement: Disconnect of target or reviver invalidates the current revive transaction. Reconnect creates a new connection session and must reconcile life state rather than resume an old timer blindly.

facts.subject: respawn state reset
facts.statement: Respawn must use an explicit reset/preserve matrix covering life state, health, gamemode, inventory, effects, input permissions, tags, scoreboard mirrors, pending teleports, revive ownership, and arena participation.

facts.subject: participant predicates
facts.statement: DEAD_CONFIRMED, RESPAWNING, ELIMINATED, and stale/disconnected life generations must not satisfy active, ready, alive-team, objective, or revive-source predicates unless the game mode explicitly defines otherwise.

facts.subject: health-change processing
facts.statement: Do not implement revive/downed correction by directly changing health inside the same entityHealthChanged handler without a recursion guard/deferred transition. Use a guarded state transition and explicit verification.

facts.subject: revive completion
facts.statement: Revive completion must be idempotent: one generation can transition DOWNED/BEING_REVIVED to REVIVED at most once, and duplicate completion callbacks must become no-ops.
